documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 17Th October 2026

analysis.summary: Kross Limited reported strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV segment, consistent tractor and agri segment demand, and progressive capacity expansions. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 reached ₹235.1 crore with a profit after tax of ₹19.7 crore. Management highlighted ongoing strategic initiatives such as the commercial production of extruded axle beams, progress on the seamless tube facility, and increasing export contributions. Kross Limited reported its best first-quarter top line for FY27 with revenue reaching INR185.35 crores, reflecting a 32% year-on-year growth driven by demand across medium and heavy commercial vehicles, trailers, and tractors. Management highlighted that capacity expansions, including the commissioning of the axle beam extrusion line, are on track and supporting robust volume performance.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q3 and Q4 volumes are expected to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: With healthy order books, sustained demand in the trailer and tractor segments, and multiple capacity expansion initiatives nearing completion, Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company targets to increase export contribution to around 8% in the next two years.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

guidance.claim: Management targets exports to contribute around 8% of revenue in the next two years.
guidance.quote: Gradually expanding global presence; exports contribution targeted ~8% of revenue in next two years

guidance.claim: The company targets 15% of total revenue from the agriculture segment in the next two years.
guidance.quote: Targeting 15% of total revenue from agriculture segment in next two years

demand_outlook.claim: M&HCV segment momentum continued with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor and agri segment demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports currently contribute approximately 8% of the total component business.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our total component business.

demand_outlook.claim: Indications from OEMs point to a strong September Q2 and subsequently Q3 and Q4 supported by healthy order books.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4.

demand_outlook.claim: April 2026 tractor industry data remained encouraging and the company remains on track to increase the contribution of tractor segment sales.
demand_outlook.quote: April 2026 tractor industry data remained encouraging and we remain on track to meaningfully increase the contribution of tractor segment sales to our revenues.

demand_outlook.claim: Export efforts are underway to grow the share in exports in line with projections, supported by a 45% growth year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding exports, the efforts are underway to grow share in export in line with our projections, which is supported by a 45% growth year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: The CV business is expected to grow well in terms of volumes this year with good projections from September onwards up to March.
demand_outlook.quote: So Mihir, the CV business is supposed to grow well in terms of volumes this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand outlook across all OEMs remains very promising.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand outlook across all OEMs remains very promising.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained strong in April and May, with encouraging volume indications for Q3 and Q4 FY27 despite typical monsoon slowdowns.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained strong in April and May, with encouraging volume indications for Q3 and Q4 FY27 despite typical monsoon slowdowns.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor and agriculture segment delivered healthy growth with approximately 40% YoY observed in Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Delivered healthy growth with ~40% YoY observed in Q1.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment recorded noticeable volume growth driven by the addition of new fabricators and deeper market penetration.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Recorded noticeable volume growth driven by addition of new fabricators and deeper market penetration.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced

capex_expansion.claim: Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

capex_expansion.claim: For the seamless tube facility, mills are installed and production trials are targeted for February–March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Seamless tube facility: mills installed, production trials targeted for February–March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: High-pressure moulding line in the foundry is progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: High-pressure moulding line (Foundry) Progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Tipping jack installed capacity is 800 kits per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle beam extrusion line has started production and is now in production.
capex_expansion.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on schedule with the piercing mill received and sizing and straightening mills on the high seas.
capex_expansion.quote: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track. Piercing mill has been received, sizing and straightening mills are on the high seas and this is progressing as per schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, which will double the foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle beam extrusion plant has been commissioned, with commercial production to begin soon in August 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle Beam Extrusion Plant commissioned and Commercial production to begin soon in August 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The high-pressure moulding line foundry is on track for completion by September 2026, which will double casting capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: High-pressure moulding line (Foundry) on track for completion by September 2026, which will double casting capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Forging capacity was significantly enhanced with the commissioning of multiple high-tonnage presses and an additional 1000-tonne press ordered.
capex_expansion.quote: Forging capacity significantly enhanced with commissioning of multiple high-tonnage presses. Additional 1000-tonne press ordered.

margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year-on-year to 133.12 million.

margins_costs.claim: A recent steel price settlement retrospective to all suppliers was given around July 15th at INR4,700 per kilo.
margins_costs.quote: This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

margins_costs.claim: The tractor industry has already settled on a percentage for conversion price increase given retrospectively from April 1st.
margins_costs.quote: The tractor industry has already settled on a percentage which has been given retrospective from April 1st and very soon the CV industry will also be settling on the same.

margins_costs.claim: Prices in the trailer business were increased with effect from April 1st by approximately 3% to 5%.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have increased our prices on our trailer business with effect from 1st of April itself, right.

margins_costs.claim: Profit growth was moderated compared to revenue growth primarily due to higher depreciation expenses from strategic capital investments.
margins_costs.quote: Profit growth was moderated compared to robust revenue growth, primarily due to higher depreciation expenses from our strategic capital investments

margins_costs.claim: Extruded technology adoption is expected to drive EBITDA margins to improve significantly above 50% utilization.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expected to improve significantly above 50% utilization

margins_costs.claim: Tipping jacks are expected to generate approximately 15% margins on safety-critical products.
margins_costs.quote: Margin Potential: Expected ~15% margins on these safety-critical products.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 44.8%.
